title: Braised Cabbage with Ukrainian Flair
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring earthy flavors and a hint of Ukrainian tradition. Serve with a side of crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large bowl over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped cabbage, caraway seeds, vegetable broth, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper to the bowl. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the cabbage is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
